summary: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), also called AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), is the practice of optimizing brands and content for visibility inside AI-driven search and answer engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot) rather than only traditional blue-link SEO. We want Instagram creators who educate or comment on how AI is changing search and discovery, so they could plausibly share or discuss a GEO Playbook.
